product_metadata.title: Secura 𝗠𝗶𝗹𝗸 𝗙𝗿𝗼𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿, Electric Milk Steamer Stainless Steel, 8.4oz/250ml Automatic Hot and Cold Foam Maker and Milk Warmer for Latte, Macchiato (Black)
features: 【Milk Foam Maker】：Automatic electric milk frother has a captivating frothing function - perfect for cappuccinos, macchiatos, lattes and more. One button provides three functions, can make hot/cold foam and hot milk, suitable for home use.

【Perfect Capacity】：Milk frother and steamer can hearting 8.4oz/250ml hot milk for delicious breakfast, or frothing a 4.2oz/125ml froth to pair with a tasty coffee to easily create a café-quality drink at home.
【Quick Working】：Milk frother electric frothing cold milk froth in 1 minute, frothing hot milk froth in 2-3 minutes, and heating hot milk in 3-4 minutes.
【Easy to Clean】：Coffee frother is made of stainless steel and non-stick coating inside, with a cleaning brush for easy cleaning. All accessories are BPA-free.

【ELT Safety Certification】： ETL Listed milk frother and Strix temperature control to provide you with a safe and high-quality coffee life. Automatic milk frother has a 2-years warranty. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
